sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5), https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/ — official names, descriptions and grades
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies, https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi — PSN progress targets (0/N) and grades
Guides below are this guide's own words, written from the official descriptions. Anything not yet checked in the game is flagged as such.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through this guide's roadmap in order and it arrives on its own at the end. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and finish it. It is the game's first mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn — just follow the on-screen objectives and the story does the rest. Nothing here can be missed: the mission is part of the main story. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by playing its missions through in order. Chapter trophies unlock on completion, so there is no extra requirement — keep following the story. Before moving on, finish the side content that opened up during the chapter, while it is fresh. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 by playing its missions through in order. Like every chapter trophy, it unlocks on completion — no side requirement, no secret step. Clear the chapter's side strands before the story moves on, since strands can close off later. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 by playing its missions through in order. Chapter trophies unlock on completion, so the only job is to keep playing the story. Use the lull between chapters to mop up collectibles and activities in the areas the chapter opened. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by playing its missions through in order. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and it unlocks on completion like the rest. Before the final mission, clear any stranger strands still open — the endgame is the wrong time to discover one has locked. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. This is the story finale, so it unlocks when the last mission ends — it is gold because it marks the end of the story. Stock up on ammo and health before you start, and after the credits the world stays open for cleanup. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Stock up, then play the final mission to its end

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies unlock on completion, so play the mission through and the trophy follows — it cannot be missed as long as you keep playing the story. Go in with full health and ammo, use cover, and follow the mission's objectives. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach the mission Breakfast Run in the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are usually the long ones: expect several stages, so keep an eye on ammo and take the quiet approach where the mission allows it. The trophy unlocks the moment the heist ends. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach the mission The Cartel Heist in the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like every mission trophy it unlocks on completion, so the only requirement is to finish the mission. Play it when it appears in the story — it cannot be missed. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach the mission Child's Play in the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Mission trophies unlock on completion — play the mission through and the trophy is yours. If the mission has a fail state, retrying it immediately still counts; there is no penalty for a failed first attempt. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach the mission Headliners in the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. Mission trophies unlock on completion, so finish the takedown and the trophy follows. Expect airport security to be heavy — go in prepared and use the airport's cover. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach the mission VCIA Takedown in the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Mission trophies unlock on completion — play the operation through to its end and the trophy pops. Operations tend to be combat-heavy, so stock up before you start. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach the mission Operation Savage Glory in the story

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the game's own checklist of story, side strands, collectibles, activities and the rest. Watch the completion percentage in the in-game stats and use this guide's roadmap to mop up whatever is left. It is the last trophy for most players, and it is gold for a reason: it takes everything else first. PSN tracks the target as 0/100. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Clear every side strand, collectible and activity
Check the in-game stats until it reads 100%

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, airtime, near misses and the like, as the game counts them. Stunts add up fastest when you drive fast and use ramps and jumps; the counter is tracked by PSN (0/250), so you can watch it climb. Work on it naturally while driving between objectives, then grind the remainder on a stretch of open road with good jumps. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Drive fast and take jumps and ramps
Chain stunts while travelling between objectives
Grind the remainder on open roads

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — PSN tracks the count as 0/9. Open the activities menu and try each type it lists once: one race, one fishing trip, one arcade game, and so on. The exact list of 9 types is not pinned down yet — the in-game menu shows which ones you have tried, so work down that list. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try each of the 9 activity types once

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — PSN tracks them as 0/42. Visit the shooting ranges across Leonida and gold every challenge: steady aim, controlled bursts, and learning each challenge's layout. If a challenge resists, retry it right away — your best medal is what counts. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Gold every one of the 42 challenges

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations — PSN tracks them as 0/14. Drone races are won by flying the course cleanly: cut corners where the gates allow, keep the drone low and steady, and learn each course's turns. Each location is a separate race, so work through the map one location at a time. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location
Win the race there, then move to the next location

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — PSN tracks them as 0/20. Any race type counts as long as it is a different race, so vary the events rather than replaying one you already won. Learn each course's corners and use the fastest vehicle you have for that race's class. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: land the better catch before Cal does. Watch the line tension, reel steadily, and do not let the fish snap the line. WATCH OUT: if Cal's challenge is offered only once, take it when it appears rather than putting it off — that part is not yet verified in the game. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.missableNote: Cal's fishing challenge may be offered only once — take it when it appears. Not yet verified in the game.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Take Cal's fishing challenge when it is offered

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish one full game at an arcade machine. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you are best at and play it to its end. Arcades are found around Vice City and Leonida. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Play one game through to its end

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a series of side missions — play each one as it appears and the finale unlocks the trophy. WATCH OUT: side strands can lock as the story moves on, so finish Andy's missions before pushing far into later chapters. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.missableNote: Side strands can lock as the story advances — finish Andy's missions before moving into later chapters.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Meet Andy and play his strand

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — PSN tracks them as 0/8. Strangers appear as markers on the map: talk to them, play their strand through, and repeat for eight different strangers. WATCH OUT: strands can close off as the story advances, so clear them as you meet them instead of saving them for after the story. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.missableNote: Stranger strands can close off as the story advances — clear them as you meet them.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Talk to strangers marked on the map

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is a series of side missions — play each one as it appears and the finale unlocks the trophy. WATCH OUT: side strands can lock as the story moves on, so finish Randy's missions before pushing far into later chapters. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is a series of side missions — play each one as it appears and the finale unlocks the trophy. WATCH OUT: side strands can lock as the story moves on, so finish Tyrone's missions before pushing far into later chapters. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Meet Tyrone and play his strand

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — PSN tracks them as 0/18. Meditation spots sit in scenic places around the map: visit each one and meditate there. The exact spots are not pinned down yet; the in-game map and world markers show them as you explore, so sweep the map region by region. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt targets one specific animal — follow his strand's clues to find it, then make the shot count. Bring a scoped weapon and approach from downwind so the animal does not bolt. WATCH OUT: stranger strands can lock as the story advances, so do Bret's hunt when it opens. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.missableNote: Stranger strands can lock as the story advances — do Bret's hunt when it opens.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Meet Bret and take the hunt
Track the unique animal and take it down

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets — PSN tracks them as 0/3. Cards are hidden around Leonida: pick them up and complete three full sets. Cards are a pure collectible grind, so sweep the map area by area and tick them off in this guide's checklist. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — PSN tracks them as 0/100. WAiNK It is a photo or tag activity at marked spots: visit 100 of them and do the action at each. Work through the map region by region and the count climbs steadily as you explore. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — PSN tracks them as 0/50. Challenges are the game's side objectives: races, stunts, activities and more all feed the count. Play broadly and the number rises on its own; the last few are a matter of picking off the challenge types you have not touched yet. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Use the countryside or water to break the search, keep moving, and do not let the law spot you again until the stars are gone. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Reach a 4-star wanted level, then lose it

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner alongside, keeping the wanted level alive between them: plan a route with three shops close together and move fast. If the wanted level drops, the chain breaks and you start again. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Plan a route with 3 shops close together
Rob all 3 in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — PSN tracks them as 0/100. The game counts each new vehicle type you find, so drive everything you see. Variety is the trick: try different classes and districts rather than the same car twice, and check car parks, garages and the roads between towns. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with a group of enemies in front of you and drop five before it ends. Pick a fight with clustered enemies, line the shots up before you activate it, and aim for the closest ones first. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a group of clustered enemies
Activate Combat Focus and take down 5

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. The description points at leaving the airport in an unauthorised way, so try taking off from the airport in a plane without clearance, or otherwise slipping out without following the normal departure. The exact trigger is not pinned down yet — this is our own reading of the official description, not a verified step. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Leave in a plane without following the normal departure

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are tanks, so this trophy is about tangling with one — the exact trigger is not pinned down yet. Our own reading of the official description: expect it to involve stealing, surviving or destroying a Rhino tank, so try it in free roam once tanks appear. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find a Rhino tank in free roam

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, nobody spotting you. Plan the approach, keep out of sight lines, grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — slip out and try again. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet approach

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — PSN tracks them as 0/5. Bank vaults are bigger jobs than shops: plan each one, get in, take the vault and get out clean, five times. Each successful escape adds to the count. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Rob it and escape, 5 times in total

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and escape before the law closes in. Pick a quiet stretch of road so you have room to run, and have a fast getaway car ready. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on the road
Stop it, take the cash and escape

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — PSN tracks them as 0/52. Visit every named area on the map and the counter ticks as each new area registers. Drive the whole map, including the outskirts and the islands, and mop up the last areas with a methodical sweep. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Drive through every part of the map

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — PSN tracks them as 0/9. Each gang runs illegal operations somewhere in Leonida: hit one per gang, nine in total. The gangs and their turf are not pinned down yet; the world markers and story contacts point at them, so follow those leads as the story introduces each gang. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find an illegal operation for one gang
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. The exact bar is not pinned down yet — any beachfront spot on Ocean Beach that serves cocktails should do. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Order a cocktail with a view

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through a showroom's frontage — the 'classic style' hints at the old showroom smash. Pick a showroom, build speed on the approach and go straight through the glass. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Drive through its frontage at speed

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley — the trophy is about the follow-through, so finish your game there. The alley is named in the description: Kolt & Associates. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is cryptic — it points at a partner moment that lands with the public. The exact trigger is not pinned down yet; keep playing the partner storyline and its public-facing moments, and this should unlock as the story unfolds. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Watch for a public-facing partner moment

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count to 500 — the game counts the choices you make, so keep deciding as they come and the number climbs. WATCH OUT: choices are made once, so if the game lets you keep a manual save, keep one before the big decisions. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.missableNote: Choices are made once — keep a manual save before big decisions, if the game allows it.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Keep making choices as they come

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description points at succeeding on a second attempt: when something fails the first time, try it again right away. The exact trigger is not pinned down yet — a failed-then-passed attempt is the shape of it, so retry failures instead of walking away. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.missableNote: A retry moment — if it is tied to one event, a first failure you walk away from may cost it. Not yet verified in the game.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: When an attempt fails, try it again right away

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description points at witnessing something strange — a weird world event. Keep an eye out while exploring, especially in the odd corners of the map. The exact event is not pinned down yet; this is our own reading of the official description, not a verified step. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.missableNote: A strange world event — it may be a one-off. Keep exploring and watch for it. Not yet verified in the game.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore the odd corners of Leonida
Witness the strange event when it happens

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A drive-by with a melee weapon: lean out of a moving vehicle and knock someone down with a melee attack. Line up a slow pass past a pedestrian and swing as you go by. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle
Lean out and knock someone down in a drive-by

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts — PSN tracks the total as 0/250000. Marked bills come from robberies: pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the total adds up. Robberies feed this directly, so it climbs alongside the other money trophies. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Rob shops, vaults and trucks for marked bills

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — PSN tracks the total as 0/100000. Buy clothes, food, weapons and more: every shop purchase counts toward the total. It climbs naturally as you play, so spend on the gear you actually want instead of buying junk for its own sake. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — PSN tracks them as 0/8. Buy every garage property on the market, eight in total. Save up and buy them as they appear; garages also store the vehicles you collect, so they pay off for the vehicle trophies too. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — PSN tracks them as 0/10. Use the Scooter Bros app to register vehicles you find, ten in total. Register each new vehicle as you discover it so the count keeps pace with your collection. Source for the name, description, grade and target: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. The advice here is our own, from the official description.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Register it in the Scooter Bros app, 10 times in total
